g.text: +Task(name: String, description: String, dueDate: LocalDate, validator: TaskValidator)
+updateTask(id: UUID, name: String, description: String, dueDate: LocalDate, completed: boolean): void
A project can contain zero or more tasks.
Each task can belong to at most one project.
Tasks without a project are allowed.
Stage 2 still supports a single user.
The user owns tasks and projects.
Each task belongs to at least one category.
A category can be assigned to zero or more tasks.
